findings.title: Unusual behaviour in ptsematest[2]
findings.summary: ptsematest[2] (prio 80) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 4 of its 4 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 80 ms. It stands out in: time blocked on a mutex (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), time asleep (lower than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is many threads serialised on one mutex, but only loosely (distance 3.78 against 1.716 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
